policy: Use source-derived geometry and documented assembly scenes. Review actual downloaded files, dimensions, origin, axes, asset-specific usage rules and attribution before use. Do not claim CAD fidelity without measurements.

assets.name: NASA Space Launch System Block 1
assets.intended_use: Primary visual starting point for SLS Block 1 in pad and flight scenes.
likely_formats_listed_on_source: ZIP model downloads; inspect extracted archive for available formats
checks_before_integration: Confirm model scale against 98.27 m reference height.
Inspect whether asset includes Orion/ICPS/pad or only a vehicle model.
Record coordinate axes, forward/up orientation, origin, polygon/material count and units.
Verify markings/configuration and asset-specific credit/usage guidance.
Optimize mesh/materials for real-time Three.js without altering the vehicle silhouette materially.
assets.license_state: Review NASA 3D Resources usage guidelines and any item-specific notices; store attribution with asset.

assets.name: NASA Orion Capsule
assets.intended_use: Crew module for separated-spacecraft, orbital and entry scenes.
checks_before_integration: Add or source separate European Service Module and arrays if absent.
Create a consistent spacecraft body-frame origin; record whether origin is at geometric center or reference point.
Check heat-shield normal and positive body axes.
assets.license_state: Review item-specific usage and attribution guidance.

assets.name: VAB, mobile launcher, crawler and LC-39B scene
assets.intended_use: Factory/VAB stacking, rollout and launch-pad scene. Use an available permitted asset or create simplified procedural geometry.
checks_before_integration: Do not claim exact facility dimensions unless independently sourced.
Use the documented scene sequence; label internal manufacturing details as educational reconstruction.
Keep flight-vehicle geometry separate from facility visualization.
assets.license_state: Search catalog and verify each asset; do not assume a specific VAB/LC-39B model exists in the catalog until downloaded and inspected.
